title: Single-Centred Dyon Indices of the Z2 CHL Model Are Positive at Q^2 <= 2
description: LaTeX source, PDF and exact-arithmetic verification code for the paper on Sen's positivity conjecture for the single-centred dyon index of the Z2 CHL model of N = 4 string theory, proved for every charge with Q^2 = 1 or 2 and its duality orbit.
